title: 1,3,4-oxadiazole derivatives: synthesis, characterization, antifungal activity, DNA binding investigations, TD-DFT calculations, and molecular modelling.
authors: Mehandi, Rabiya; Twala, Charmy; Ahmedi, Saiema; Fatima, Aysha; Ul Islam, Khursheed; Rana, Manish; Sultana, Razia; Manzoor, Nikhat; Javed, Saleem; Mahfuzul Haque, Mohammad; Iqbal, Jawed; Rahisuddin; Nishat, Nahid
one_liner_zh: 该文合成1,3,4-噁二唑衍生物并研究其抗真菌活性及与Ct-DNA的结合，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心为小分子药物设计，非TF-DNA互作体系，方法上仅含常规对接和TD-DFT，缺乏AI或MD深度建模。
abstract: 1,3,4-Oxadiazole-based heterocyclic analogs (3a-3m) were synthesized via cyclization of Schiff bases with substituted aldehydes in the presence of bromine and acetic acid. The structural clarification of synthesized molecules was carried out with various spectroscopic techniques such as FT-IR,(1)H and (13)C-NMR, UV-visible spectroscopy, and mass spectrometry. In-vitro antifungal activity was performed against C. albicans, C. glabrata and C. tropicalis and analogs 3g, 3i, and 3m showed potent MIC at 200 microg/ml and excellent ZOI measurements of 17-21 nm. The cell viability on Huh7 for lead molecules 3g, 3i, and 3m was found to be 99.5%, 92.3%, and 86.9% at 20, 10, and 20 muM, respectively. The antioxidant activity of molecules 3 g, 3i, and 3 m was estimated and exhibited great IC(50) values of 0.104 +/- 0.021, 0.145 +/- 0.05, and 0.165 +/- 0.018 mug/mL with DPPH and 0.107 +/- 0.04, 0.191 +/- 0.12, and 0.106 +/- 0.08 with H(2)O(2), respectively. The binding interaction mode for the lead molecules was also carried out with Ct-DNA using the absorption, emission, CV, CD, and Time resolve fluorescence techniques. The results showed good binding constant (K(b)) values of 9.1 x 10(5), 9.94 x 10(5), and 9.32 x 10(5) M(-1) for 3g, 3i, and 3m, respectively. TD-DFT study of compounds 3g, 3i, and 3m was done to find out HOMO/LUMO energy levels, surface study of the molecular electrostatic potential, Mulliken population analysis, and natural bond orbitals showing the linkages between the donors and acceptors.Molecular docking of three lead analogs with PDB ID: 1BNA and molecular modelling of compounds 3g, 3i, and 3m with C. albicans CYP51 protein (PDB ID: 5FSA) were carried out.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 通过席夫碱与取代醛在溴和乙酸存在下的环化反应，合成了1,3,4-噁二唑类杂环类似物（3a-3m）。采用多种光谱技术对合成分子进行了结构确认，包括FT-IR、¹H和¹³C-NMR、紫外-可见光谱以及质谱法。体外抗真菌活性测试针对白色念珠菌（C. albicans）、光滑念珠菌（C. glabrata）和热带念珠菌（C. tropicalis）进行，类似物3g、3i和3m显示出强效的最低抑菌浓度（MIC）为200微克/毫升，并具有优异的抑菌圈（ZOI）测量值，范围为17-21毫米。对先导分子3g、3i和3m在Huh7细胞上的细胞活力测定显示，在20、10和20微摩尔浓度下，细胞活力分别为99.5%、92.3%和86.9%。评估了分子3g、3i和3m的抗氧化活性，其IC(50)值分别为0.104 ± 0.021、0.145 ± 0.05和0.165 ± 0.018微克/毫升（使用DPPH法），以及0.107 ± 0.04、0.191 ± 0.12和0.106 ± 0.08（使用H₂O₂法）。此外，通过吸收、发射、循环伏安法（CV）、圆二色谱（CD）和时间分辨荧光技术，研究了先导分子与小牛胸腺DNA（Ct-DNA）的结合相互作用模式。结果显示，3g、3i和3m的结合常数（K(b)）值分别为9.1 × 10⁵、9.94 × 10⁵和9.32 × 10⁵ M⁻¹。对化合物3g、3i和3m进行了TD-DFT研究，以确定HOMO/LUMO能级、分子静电势表面研究、Mulliken布居分析以及自然键轨道，展示供体与受体之间的连接。对三个先导类似物与PDB ID: 1BNA进行了分子对接，并对化合物3g、3i和3m与白色念珠菌CYP51蛋白（PDB ID: 5FSA）进行了分子建模。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
